build: Build 1.260 "Lore's End" (2021-06-27; last Steam announcement seen)

package.basis: Desk only: Steam store/appdetails, 561 English Steam reviews via the review API, Steam news, and the NGU Idle fandom wiki; not played.

fun.source: desk estimate: below Cookie Clicker 75.5 (idler) because reviews pair the humour and depth with a guide-dependent UI and week-long walls; well above the mediocre idle RPG 30.8; 95.7% positive of 10,922 English reviews keeps it in the promising band.

evidence.quote: elementary level MS Paint 1995 drawings
Loot over 350 hand-drawn and unique equipment ... Over 300 bosses, each with their own hand-drawn art!

dims.note: Deliberately crude joke art; consistent in its crudeness and recognisable, but not craft.

evidence.quote: The presentation is also very basic. The graphics are simple

dims.note: Progress bars and static portraits; no review praises animation.

evidence.quote: The interface is HELL.
Absolutely needs a guide to follow to get through
then I heavily recommend joining their discord to read what to focus on

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~50). Functional but joke-dense and guide-dependent; three independent complaints.

evidence.quote: No mention of music or sound in 561 English reviews read via the API (inference, not listened)

dims.note: Inferred from silence in reviews; treat as weak.

evidence.quote: progression is slow in the beginning but trust the process
For early game, do 30 minute runs.

dims.note: Adventure idle from the start and rebirths in the first hour, but a terse start that pushes players to guides.

evidence.quote: the game gets a lot more idle after the first 3 titans
you see a new one oppening quite slow
Expect a week or more between goals

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~50). Great early unfolding, then week-scale walls. Ending exists (Build 1.260 added the final titans); reviewers took ~2-5.5 years.

evidence.quote: The best ratio is 1:37.5k:1.
putting off some additional growth for now for the massive exponential growth you'll achieve later

dims.note: Many interacting systems (energy/magic, NGUs, titans, gear, challenges) but optimal allocations are solved by guides; one meta per stage.

evidence.quote: the offline mode keeps making your stats better for up to a year after you last played
Works offline, but no items drop while you are offline.
where Arbitrary Points (AP) and Kongregate's currency Kreds can be spent

dims.note: Free; AP is earned in play and also sold (Steam IAP / Kreds) for timed potions and boosts. Reviewers call purchases fair; offline loses item drops; some content needs days of running.

evidence.quote: the silly graphics give dopamine!

dims.note: Humour and bosses carry the feedback; little evidence of layered audiovisual payoff.

evidence.quote: Bugs: [checked] Never heard of
my computer has crashed when the only thing I am running is this game
Build 1.260: Lore's End (2021-06-27), latest announcement

dims.note: Stable and light; one crash report; development effectively finished in 2021.

evidence.quote: hundreds of hours of content
5 years and a half it took me to finish this game
I'm about 3-6 months away from beating the game completely

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~80). 300 bosses, 350+ items, multiple difficulties, an ending. Lapse: "endgame is barebones" and half the bosses are placeholder text (negative review).

evidence.quote: experience the joy of Numbers Going Up!
Very fun and funny idler.

dims.note: Identity is the humour, not a mechanical pitch nobody else owns.

evidence.quote: platforms: Windows only on Steam; supported_languages: 'English'; categories include Steam Cloud
[Kartridge] The game will make a local backup every 30 minutes.

dims.note: Steam (Windows) plus web portals (Kongregate/Kartridge); English only; no mobile.

learn.practice: Gate automation on stat thresholds the player can see coming (AutoKill a titan once Power/Toughness clear a named bar), so the next automation is a visible goal rather than a purchase.
learn.evidence: https://ngu-idle.fandom.com/wiki/New_Player_Guide_(Truth) "can be AutoKilled once you have 3K power and 2.5K toughness"

learn.practice: Let personality carry a numbers-heavy game: named, joke bosses and item flavour make each new floor/biome memorable even with cheap art.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198041100695/recommended/1147690/ "Humor on the good side of crude and you do feel a sense of progression"

learn.practice: Avoid the guide-dependence trap: NGU players are told to follow Discord/wiki ratios; expose the right allocation in place (tooltips that turn green when a skill is capped, which NGU itself does for Basic Training).
learn.evidence: https://ngu-idle.fandom.com/wiki/New_Player_Guide_(Truth) "the hover text (\"On rebirth, your new cap will be ...\") will turn green"
